cve_description: The description provided by the CVE numbering authority (e.g. NIST NVD).
django_description: The description provided in the official Django security release.

cwe.name: Name of the Common Weakness Enumeration category

affected_versions.version_not_affected: The version number that contains the fix (affected versions are strictly less than this, e.g., < 1.11.29)

patches.commit: The full commit hash of the patch applied to this version
patches.same_as_stable: Boolean: true if the patch content (diff) is identical to the patch applied to the stable version of Django for this CVE. This helps identify backported patches without changes.
